Long list of saved DuckyScript scripts as full-width outlined rows: title + 'N lines • ✓ Valid / ❌ Errors • Nms'

evidence.note: List of scripts with key attributes (line count, validity, est. time); verified live: clicking a row replaces the list with an 'Edit Script' view showing name field, script body, stats footer, Update/Delete/Export/Back buttons and Execute Script
Each script is a whole-row button with #111 fill, 2px #222 border, 4px radius; bold title + muted meta line
Error variant shows red ❌ Errors in meta line
Validity shown as inline meta text '❌ Errors' / '✓ Valid', not a separate badge/pill
Only a trigger button for a quick-start guide; no tour visible in capture

structure.layout: single-page web app: top nav bar with brand, page buttons and a prominent 'Connect to Device' button; full-width segmented tabs (Text / Duckyscript) above a tab panel containing a warning line, section heading, two full-width action buttons and a long single-column list of script rows that drill into an editor view

aesthetics.typography: Monospace throughout: Ubuntu Sans Mono for UI text, buttons, list rows and meta; Roboto Mono bold for the 'ToothPaste' wordmark (36px) and h6 headings ('Duckyscript Manager', 'Connect to Device' at 20px).
aesthetics.typeScale: Compact: 36px/700 wordmark, 20px headings, 16px nav, 14px bold row titles and buttons, 12px muted meta lines; hierarchy via weight and grey vs white rather than size.

notes: Black page with a faint square grid-line texture (full-page SVG) evoking graph paper/terminal. Everything is monospace. Header bar is near-black; the 'Connect to Device' call-to-action is outlined in pinkish red (#dd4058) with a wireless-off icon and a hidden 'Hold to Rename' secondary label (press-and-hold interaction). Paste nav item marked active by a white 1px outline. The two primary action buttons split width 50/50 in saturated green and terracotta orange — the only filled color on the page. Script rows are uniform full-width dark bars; status uses ✓ text in grey and a red ❌ emoji for errors. Detail editor (seen live) replaces the list with a script textarea, stats footer ('Lines: 7 Commands: 5 Est. Time'), and a large 'Execute Script' button.
